spec.name: Convoy Hauler Mk-IV
spec.description: A low-poly cyberpunk armoured six-wheel convoy hauler with a hooded cab, gun turret and a sealed glowing cargo pod strapped on its flatbed.
spec.layout: Long heavy truck facing +Z. Front: angular armoured cab with sloped hood, slit windshield with cyan neon visor strip, bull bar and amber light bar. Behind the cab a roof-mounted turret. The mid and rear carry a long flat chassis deck with three axles (six wheels: front, mid, rear) with chunky faceted tyres and neon-edged wheel arches. The sealed cargo pod, a big chamfered capsule-box, sits on the deck behind the cab, held by yellow-black hazard straps and corner clamps, with magenta glowing seams and a cyan status panel. Everything is blocky and faceted with neon cyan and magenta accents against dark gunmetal plating with yellow hazard trim, decals as SVG (stripes, warning glyphs, kanji-like codes, unit number).

parts.builds: Frame, flat deck slab with hazard-stripe edges, side skirts, fuel tanks, exhaust stacks, rear bumper with tail lights, underbody dark plating, deck bolt rows and tie-down rings, panelled paint on the plates, neon underglow strips (cyan) along the sides.
parts.attaches: Cab starts at cabFloor; pod rests on podBase; axles hang at axleFront/axleMid/axleRear; body joint.

parts.builds: Six faceted chunky tyres (octagonal lathes) with tread blocks, rims with bolts and glowing cyan hub caps, wheel arch fenders with neon edge trim, axle housings and suspension springs/dampers between axle and chassis. Each wheel rides its wheel joint.
parts.attaches: Wheel joints at axleFront, axleMid and axleRear lines; arches meet chassis side at y 1.0.

parts.builds: Armoured angular cab: sloped hood and engine block with vents, slit windshield (glass colour, glowing cyan visor strip), side windows with armour shutters, roof plates, mirrors, antenna array, amber light bar and headlights (glow) on the front, bull bar with hazard stripes, door panels with unit number and warning decals as SVG textures, grille with magenta glow.
parts.attaches: Sits on chassis at cabFloor; roof at cabRoof; turret base at turretRing.

parts.builds: Roof-mounted remote gun turret: rotating ring base, faceted armoured housing, twin barrels with muzzle brakes and heat sleeves on gunPitch, ammo box and belt, sensor eye with glowing magenta lens (SVG eye decal), small antenna, hazard stripe on the ring.
parts.attaches: Base ring at turretRing on the cab roof; rides turretYaw and gunPitch.

parts.attaches: Rests on deck at podBase; clamps meet chassis deck at deckTop; rides pod joint.

spec.name: Six-Wheeled Railgun Carrier
spec.description: A low-poly sci-fi military six-wheeled armoured carrier carrying a long electromagnetic railgun on its back, planted on four deployed stabiliser legs.
spec.layout: Long, low armoured hull facing +Z. Front (z 3.2 to 4.5): sloped glacis, angular cab with a slit visor window on top of the hull, and headlights. Middle: flat deck with the turret ring at z=-0.4. Rear (z -4.5): engine deck, exhaust vents and a cargo/ammo bay. Three wheel axles per side at z=2.8, 0.2 and -2.8, with big chunky tyres (radius 0.6) set in angular wheel arches. Four stabiliser legs fold out diagonally from the hull sides near the front and rear axles to square footpads on the floor, which are wider than the tyres. A big railgun on a turret rides the deck with a long barrel extending forward over the cab, flanked by two parallel rails, glowing cyan coils, a recoil sleeve and a muzzle brake. The railgun's rails and coils glow neon cyan. Style: chunky faceted slabs, bold yellow hazard trim, olive-grey armour panels with riveted seams, dark gunmetal rails, and decals such as stencilled numbers and a unit emblem.

parts.builds: Main armoured chassis: lofted/faceted lower tub and upper hull with sloped glacis and tail, panelled olive paint with riveted seams (clockwork panelled over hull paint), yellow hazard stripes on the lower skirt and rear bumper, deck plating with hatches and grab rails, side armour skirts over wheel arches, and a rear engine deck with vents and exhaust stacks. Stencilled unit number and emblem decals on the flanks.
parts.attaches: Sits on the wheels and carries the cab at cabRoof, the turret at turretRing, and the leg sockets at legFrontL and legRearL.

parts.builds: Angular command cab at the front of the hull: wedge body, slit glass visor with a drawn cyan HUD texture, roof hatch and antenna cluster, sensor pod, two headlights with lamp glow, hazard trim, and a sloped front armour plate with a tow hook.
parts.attaches: Sits on the hull deck at deckTop y=1.75 with its roof at cabRoof; it stays clear of the turret ring and the gun path, which passes above it.

parts.builds: Six large chunky low-poly tyres with tread blocks painted or extruded, faceted steel rims with bolt rings and hub caps, axle housings, suspension arms and shock absorbers linking to the hull, and mud-splash paint at the bottom. All the tyres rest on y = 0 and are 1.2 m in diameter. Each tyre spins on its wheel joint.
parts.attaches: Wheels are centred on the axleFront, axleMid and axleRear lines at x = ±1.85, and suspension arms reach in to the hull sides at x = ±1.6.

parts.builds: Four deployed stabiliser legs: a hull-side mounting block, a thick hydraulic upper strut with a piston sleeve, and an angled lower leg ending in a wide square footpad with a hazard-striped rim and ground-grip ribs. The legs extend diagonally outward and down, and they separate wider than the tyres. They carry yellow warning bands, glowing red status lamps and exposed hydraulic hoses (swept tubes).
parts.attaches: Roots on the hull sides at legFrontL, legRearL and their mirrors at x = ±1.45, y = 1.1; the footpads at footFrontL and footRearL (x ±2.9) rest on y = 0.

parts.builds: The signature railgun. A rotating turret base with a ring bearing and armoured housing at turretRing, a cradle with trunnions at gunPivot, and a very long barrel assembly: two parallel gunmetal rails with a cyan glow gap between them, ring coils (glowing neon cyan) spaced along the barrel, a recoil sleeve, a heavy breech block with a power cable bundle and capacitor banks (boxes with glowing indicator strips), a muzzle brake with a glowing tip at muzzle, and yellow warning bands. A small drawn-texture warning label sits on the breech.
parts.attaches: The turret base sits on the hull at turretRing (y = 1.75) and the barrel pivots at gunPivot, with its tip at muzzle (z = 5.2) held above the cab roof so it clears cabRoof by at least 0.3 m.
